programmes.d: Gibbs and the team investigate when a weekend call to an NCIS tip line results in the death of two agents. The NCIS team discovers a tip about terrorist activity was a trap that resulted in the death of two agents.
Gibbs and the team investigate when McGee's fictional book about an NCIS agent becomes reality. McGee is horrified when a Petty Officer on whom he based the character for his latest book is murdered.
Director Shepard takes a huge risk and agrees to meet an informant alone about Le Grenouille, but the meeting goes bad and her contact is killed.
As Joy and Rick feign being a genuinely engaged couple, Melanie meets Pete's judgmental mother and is stunned when she finds out who Pete's brother is.
With her trial for possessing stolen goods approaching, Elka is advised by her handsome lawyer Kirk to act senile, as Melanie, Victoria, and Joy compete for his affection.
A psychic gives Joy a pair of magical Spanx , which brings the women bad luck, including a movie audition in which Victoria is mortified to read as Melanie Griffith's mother.
In L.A., Victoria plans revenge on her nemesis Susan Lucci, Joy confronts Michael Knight, Melanie gets sentimental, and Elka talks her way onto Jimmy Kimmel's show.
Still in L.A., Victoria feuds with Susan Lucci, Joy traps Michael Knight in his lie, Elka is determined to meet Robert Redford, and Melanie emotionally parts with her house.
Elka brings home a rescue dog, Joy starts dating a man she met in her therapist's waiting room, and Victoria's agent recommends she make a sex tape to jumpstart her career.
Trying again for her green card, Joy gets engaged to a homeless man, Victoria lands a local news correspondent job, and Melanie dates a Cavaliers coach.
Victoria tries to win over the difficult kids of a man she likes, Elka is resistant to wintering in Florida with Max, and Melanie and Joy volunteer at a senior center.
A family feud erupts when hillbilly cousins (Loni Anderson and Alice Ghostley) arrive from the Other Realm.
It’s Friday the 13th, and for one day only, Sabrina can tell her friends she’s a witch.
Sabrina’s lack of attention with detail causes bad side effects to her magic.
A special visitor from the Other Realm helps Sabrina recapture the true spirit of Christmas
Tired of Mr. Kraft’s harsh rules, Sabrina concocts a potion to make him act like a teenager.
Libby is even harder to figure out after Sabrina accidentally turns her into a jigsaw puzzle.

As the NCIS Director returns from a controversial European junket, and Gibbs and his agents reluctantly prepare for Homeland Security polygraph tests, tightly woven secrets among the team unravel.
